name: Árchez (Spain)
description: Four horizontal stripes of red, white, blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Árchez (a minaret, the bars of Aragon and a saint above waves, with motto).
history: Municipal flag of Árchez; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Árchez arms — minaret, bars of Aragon and saint above waves, with motto
